question.text: For schemes investing at least 80% of total assets in permissible overseas investments, what is the redemption payment timeline?

explanation.text: The Logic: For schemes investing at least 80% of total assets in permissible overseas investments, redemption or repurchase proceeds must be transferred within five working days from the date of redemption or repurchase (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, p.267). The Trap: Shorter or longer timelines such as 3, 7, or 10 working days are not the rule for this overseas-investment category. Note: Tie the five-working-day rule to the 80% overseas-investment threshold from p.267 rather than generic settlement reasoning.
